import json,random,sys
seed=int(sys.argv[1]);random.seed(seed)
def make_case(caseidx):
 S=256;J=512;F=random.choice([2,4,8,16,32]);G=random.choice([0,1,4,16,32])
 slots=[[s,random.choice([2,5,10]),0 if s==0 else random.choice([5,10,20])] for s in range(S)]
 perm=list(range(G));random.shuffle(perm);groups=[None]*G
 if G:
  groups[perm[0]]=[-1,random.randint(64,512)]
  for ii in range(1,G):groups[perm[ii]]=[-1 if random.random()<.3 else perm[random.randrange(ii)],random.randint(16,512)]
 flows=[]
 for f in range(F):
  target=random.randint(1,64)
  ceiling=random.randint(target,min(512,max(target,random.choice([target,64,128,512]))))
  grp=-1 if G==0 or random.random()<.2 else random.randrange(G)
  flows.append([target,ceiling,grp,random.randrange(7)])
 wins=[]
 for j in range(J):
  f=j%F
  wins.append([f,0,S-1,1,1,0,random.randint(1,1000),[[0,0]]*9])
 return {'model':random.choice(['cnn','rnn']),'class_values':[random.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(7)],'stats':[random.randint(1,1000),random.randint(1,1000),random.randint(1,100)],'bucket':[512,random.choice([0,64,256,512])],'slots':slots,'flows':flows,'groups':groups,'windows':wins}
cases=[make_case(i) for i in range(2)]
print(json.dumps({'version':3,'cases':cases},separators=(',',':')))
PY
